Translations / status: Sahih International (English); Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari (Urdu). Arabic and both excerpts checked at the links below.
Relevance: Shared responsibility includes commanding right, worship and giving. This is explicit moral partnership, not proof that every juristic ruling is identical.

en.text: Source: Qur’an, Surah Al Imran (3), ayah 195.
Published English excerpt: Never will I allow to be lost the work of [any] worker among you, whether male or female;
Translations / status: Sahih International (English); Fateh Muhammad Jalandhari (Urdu). Arabic and both excerpts checked at the links below.
Relevance: The promise is followed by migration, expulsion and suffering in God’s cause, making women’s and men’s contributions visible within a community’s history.

ur.text: ماخذ: قرآنِ کریم، سورۃ آل عمران (3)، آیت 195۔

paragraphs.text: لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ

en.text: Source: Sahih al-Bukhari, no. 13; Belief, Book 2; chapter 7.
Published English excerpt: None of you will have faith till he wishes for his (Muslim) brother what he likes for himself.
Grade: Sahih; included in the named Sahih collection.
Text sources: Arabic / English / numbering: Sunnah.com. Urdu: Islamic Urdu Books; wording checked, individual translator not independently established.
Parallel: Sahih Muslim, no. 45a; wording may vary. Same counted entry.
Relevance: The checked English rendering explicitly includes “(Muslim)”. Wider duties toward others should be supported by additional evidence, not silent alteration.

paragraphs.text: مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ مَثَلُ الْجَسَدِ

en.text: Source: Sahih Muslim, no. 2586a; Virtue, Kinship and Manners, Book 45; chapter 17.
Published English excerpt: The similitude of believers in regard to mutual love, affection, fellow-feeling is that of one body;
Grade: Sahih; included in the named Sahih collection.
Text sources: Arabic / English / numbering: Sunnah.com. Published Urdu translation not verified; no substitute translation supplied.
Relevance: The bodily analogy concerns shared distress and compassion. Social solidarity is a normative obligation, not a claim of uniform interests.

entries.subtitleEn: Rebuking inherited prejudice Arabic below: contiguous excerpt.

en.text: Source: Ibn Kathir; Tafsir Ibn Kathir (Abridged).
Scholarly position / paraphrased argument: The commentary connects common descent from Adam and Eve with the identification of peoples and tribes; moral distinction depends on piety, not ancestry.
Access / status: English abridged Tafsir inspected on Quran.com; compiler’s paraphrase, not a published translation quotation.
Relevance: Use for the distinction between social identity and claims of inherited superiority.

ur.text: ماخذ: ابن کثیر؛ تفسیر ابن کثیر (مختصر انگریزی نسخہ)۔
محل: سورۂ حجرات 49:13 کی تفسیر۔
علمی مؤقف / مفہومی خلاصہ: تفسیر مشترک آدمی نسب کو قوموں اور قبیلوں کے تعارف سے جوڑتی ہے؛ اخلاقی امتیاز تقویٰ سے ہے، نسب سے نہیں۔
رسائی / حیثیت: قرآن ڈاٹ کام پر تفسیر کا مختصر انگریزی متن دیکھا گیا؛ مرتب کا مفہومی خلاصہ ہے، کسی مطبوعہ ترجمے کا لفظی اقتباس نہیں۔
مطابقت: سماجی شناخت اور موروثی برتری کے دعوے میں فرق کے لیے مفید ہے۔
متعلقہ اصل دلیل: حوالہ 061۔

en.text: Source: Syed Abul A‘la Maududi; Tafhim al-Quran.

Scholarly position / paraphrased argument: Differences in resources and capacities are interpreted as circumstances of testing and accountability, not proof that the advantaged possess greater moral worth.
Access / status: English Tafhim commentary reproduced on SurahQuran inspected; compiler’s bilingual paraphrase. Printed edition and translation credits were not independently established.
Relevance: Useful against confusing social advantage with divine approval of every hierarchy.

ur.text: ماخذ: سید ابوالاعلیٰ مودودی؛ تفہیم القرآن۔

مطابقت: سماجی فائدے کو ہر درجہ بندی کی الٰہی منظوری سمجھنے کی تردید میں مفید ہے۔
متعلقہ اصل دلیل: حوالہ 027۔

entries.subtitleUr: وسائل کے تفاوت کی آزمائشی حیثیت

Locator: Al-Hujurat 49:13, notes 28–29; social distinctions and marriage compatibility.
Scholarly position / paraphrased argument: Maududi distinguishes considerations of marriage compatibility and social custom from claims of inherent superiority by birth or caste.
Access / status: English Tafhim commentary reproduced on SurahQuran inspected; compiler’s bilingual paraphrase. Printed edition and translation credits were not independently established.
Relevance: Use for critical discussion of equality and inherited social practices; it is not an exhaustive fiqh survey.

رسائی / حیثیت: سورہ قرآن پر نقل شدہ تفہیم کا انگریزی متن دیکھا گیا؛ دو لسانی مفہومی خلاصہ مرتب کا ہے۔ مطبوعہ نسخہ اور مترجم کی تفصیل مستقلاً ثابت نہیں کی گئی۔
مطابقت: مساوات اور موروثی سماجی طریقوں کے تنقیدی مطالعے میں مفید ہے؛ یہ فقہ کا جامع تقابلی جائزہ نہیں۔
